WrenBoard 1.2.0

Install over 1.1 directly, no uninstall needed (same signing key, versionCode 3).

What's new and fixed:
- Opening Settings lands on the Settings home; FUTO's settings rows and the Payment row are kept as upstream.
- Starter words: with an empty field, suggestions come from your own typing history; I / The / You appear only when there is no history yet. Turning the toggle off leaves the empty field blank, and normal suggestions while typing keep working.
- Number row keeps digits with Shift and Caps Lock.
- Clipboard: a cancelled or interrupted swipe no longer deletes the item.
- Update prompt: clearer success / cancelled / failed messages; stale status cleared on reopen.
- GIF: still labelled "coming soon".

Testing limits: data preservation over 1.1 (settings, learned words, personal dictionary, clipboard pins) was verified on an Android emulator, not on a real phone or a Samsung device.
